title: UNO
tagline: Match colors and numbers — race to empty your hand.
setupSubtitle: First to empty their hand wins. 2–6 players.
privateHandsHint: Hide each hand between turns on a shared device.
secrecyNote: Heads up: hands are hidden in the UI, not encrypted — a snoop with devtools could peek. It's a friendly game. 🙂
chooseSwapHint: Trade your whole hand with a rival.
drewCardHint: Play it now, or keep it and pass.
challengePrompt: A Wild +4 was played on you.
passHint: Make sure only they can see the screen.

menu.localSubtitle: Play 2–6 on one screen — against friends or the computer.
menu.onlineSubtitle: Create or join a room and play friends on other devices.

status.yourTurn: Your turn — play a card or draw.
status.youPending: Draw {{n}} — or stack to pass it on.

rules.winModeHint: one round or to a score

metaDescription: UNO on Robin's Games — match colors and numbers, sting rivals with skips, reverses and wilds, and be the first to empty your hand. Play local vs bots, hot-seat, or online in real time.
